decisions.reason: Report grounds the diagnosis in the fixture: busy is AttachButton's useState local, unbound in sibling AttachmentChips; empty occurrences return null before the map; in plain phase the left guard is false so || evaluates busy, throwing ReferenceError. Cites the shipped expression and short-circuit latency.

Explains the render exception is caught by the InputZone slot error boundary which unmounts the whole dock entry (not just the remove button); the attach button lives in a separate slot (input.left) and survives; the diagnostic appears only in the browser console, no user-facing banner.

Uses the shipped v0.2.10 lib to establish || busy already existed in the baseline and notes feature.diff is inconsistent with that baseline (stale base, imageItem hoisted above callback-scoped record/status). Proposes both a rollback/re-add bisect and a minimal data-present render mount against the v0.2.10 artifact as isolation, and argues the evidence cannot prove when historical users first hit the latent path.

Fix deletes the dangling busy operand or threads it as a prop while preserving the phase guard, moves imageItem inside the map callback where record/status are scoped, adds record?.items ?? [] and event.target.closest?.() hardening — the rubric's equivalent-safe fixes.

Proposes a render smoke mounting AttachmentChips with an occurrence present in plain phase, asserting the chip/remove control renders and the error boundary captured nothing; explains empty-state-only tests miss the expression (early return null) and node --check/parsing cannot resolve free identifiers or execute the component; folds the data-present mount into pre-ship CI checks.
